name: Expressionism

influenced_by: German anxiety before and after WWI

places: Dresden and Berlin (Die Brücke, Der Blaue Reiter)
garments: not a fashion look — a painting and film movement
reacts_against: naturalistic representation, distorting color and form to render inner emotional states rather than observed reality.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Distorted or elongated figures, urban alienation, psychological turmoil, spirituality, raw emotion, masks, woodcut textures
wiki_facts.key_colours: Intense, arbitrary, symbolic, and often dissonant colors; strong, jarring contrasts; agitated and swirling brushstrokes
wiki_facts.key_values: Subjective emotional experience over objective reality; expression of inner psychological states; critique of modern society; spiritual renewal

findings: dark — about 40% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
a vivid streak — roughly 28% of the color measured is highly saturated
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
